name: meet-deck
description: Privacy-first open source Google Meet controls for Elgato Stream Deck.
author: annonator

scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:protocol && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.store:generate: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @meet-deck/chrome-extension && npm run store:generate --workspace @meet-deck/chrome-extension
scripts.pack: node scripts/clean-artifacts.mjs && npm run build && npm run validate && npm run package --workspace @meet-deck/chrome-extension && npm run pack --workspace @meet-deck/streamdeck-plugin && node scripts/create-checksums.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run release:verify && npm run validate:listing-assets && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run store:validate && npm run validate
